configureHelp: Set HOMEBRIDGE_URL, HOMEBRIDGE_USERNAME and HOMEBRIDGE_PASSWORD on the server. Tokens renew automatically. Enable accessory access in Homebridge UI.
importHelp: Import complete accessories with all compatible channels, then rename or disable channels in Hardware.
noMatches: No compatible devices. Check accessory access in Homebridge UI.

errors.notConfigured: Homebridge configuration is missing or invalid.
errors.accessDenied: Homebridge rejected the credentials or their permissions.
errors.entityMissing: A selected entity is no longer available in Homebridge.
errors.providerUnavailable: Homebridge could not be reached or returned an invalid response.
errors.instanceChanged: This link belongs to a different configured Homebridge instance.
errors.twoFactorRequired: Use a dedicated Homebridge account without two-factor authentication for this integration.
